chunks: From him, from Sulaymān ibn Dāwūd, from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from Abū Baṣīr, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The time of Maghrib is when the sun sets.

key_terms.الْمَغْرِبِ: the Maghrib salat (prayer), the sunset prayer
key_terms.وَقْتُ: the appointed time or legal beginning time of an act

ai.seo_question: When does the time of Maghrib salat begin according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states the beginning of the time for Maghrib salat (prayer). It establishes a jurisprudential ruling that Maghrib begins at the setting of the sun.
